title: Compensation for National Servicemen Injured During Service Period
what_it_is: Compensation for National Servicemen Injured During Service Period

sections.label: Support for injured servicemen
sections.summary: Injured servicemen receive medical expense payment, compensation for permanent disability, and support even after leaving service.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: If a serviceman is injured in the course of service, we will ensure that he receives the necessary assistance and support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: We will pay for all medical expenses incurred for the treatment of the service-related injury at Government and restructured hospitals or clinics, including the cost of medical supplies and equipment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: This applies as long as treatment is required, even after the Serviceman has left service or if the injury recurs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: We will also provide compensation if the service-related injury results in permanent disability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: This will be equivalent to the lump-sum compensation prescribed under the Work Injury Compensation Act (WICA).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The amount is doubled for disabilities that result from military training or operations.

sections.label: Benevolent Grants for families
sections.summary: The Benevolent Grant gives a one-off $12,000, while the Welfare Benevolent Grant provides up to $42,000 yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The Benevolent Grant is a one-off $12,000 financial grant provided to meet the immediate needs of the families of Servicemen who have sustained permanent disability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The Welfare Benevolent Grant provides mid-to-long term assistance for injured Servicemen.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: This grant provides financial support of up to $42,000 per annum to defray the family's cost of living.

sections.label: Helping Hand and Care Grants
sections.summary: Injured servicemen may apply for a one-off Helping Hand Grant and a monthly Care Support Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Injured Servicemen may apply for a one-off Helping Hand Grant of up to $5,000 and a monthly $300 Care Support Grant.
